test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Don't feel guilty for feeling disengaged from the news.
Don't feel guilty for feeling disengajed from the news.
Don't feel guiltty for feeling disengaged from the news.
Don't feel guilty for feling disengaged from the news.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"guilty"** means feeling responsible or regretful for a perceived offense or wrongdoing. (गुनहगार)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt **guilty** for breaking the vase.
 
 
 
• The word **"disengaged"** means emotionally detached or not interested in something. (अलग)
 
 
• **Example: **He seemed **disengaged **during the meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** "Don't feel guilty for feeling disengajed from the news."

 
 
• **"Disengajed"** is a misspelling of "disengaged". (गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Don't feel guiltty for feeling disengaged from the news."
 
 
• **"Guiltty"** is a misspelling of "guilty". (गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Don't feel guilty for feling disengaged from the news."
 
 
• **"Feling"** is a misspelling of "feeling". (गलत वर्तनी)
